title: AI Agent Kit Manifest
description: Schema for ai-agent-kit manifest YAML files

kit_version.description: Kit version — used for migration checks. Accepts SemVer 2.0 with optional prerelease tag (e.g. '6.3.0', '7.0.0-alpha', '7.0.0-beta.2').

hosts.description: Runtime hosts the project supports. The kit renders one template tree per host into the target. opencode → .opencode/ tree + opencode.json. claude-code → .claude/ tree + .claude/settings.json + CLAUDE.md (main-session orchestrator). Multi-host installs render both side-by-side.

vault_path.description: Root path (relative to project) where KnowledgeOS stores all docs. Default: vault (matches KnowledgeOS out-of-the-box). Legacy: .vault

language_code.description: Agent output language (IETF language tag). Embedded into _shared.md so agents use the matching i18n locale. Supported: en (English), ru (Russian).

slice_caps.description: v6.0+ hard caps on plan/step size, enforced by @Main at CONFIRM and by @CodeWriter at EXECUTE. When exceeded, @Main asks PO to split before EXECUTE; @CodeWriter returns BLOCKED with reason OVERFLOW. v6.2+ adds max_tokens_per_step (P17). Set any field to 0 to disable that cap.

max_steps.description: Max number of steps in plan.md § Implementation plan (v5 read this from feature.md § Implementation plan). 0 = no cap.

max_files_per_step.description: Max files (Create+Modify+Delete) a single @CodeWriter step may touch. 0 = no cap.

max_lines_per_step.description: Max total lines added+removed in a single @CodeWriter step (approx, from the agent's Changed Files table). 0 = no cap.

max_tokens_per_step.description: v6.2+ (P17). Estimated tokens (bytes / 4) of the STEP_CONTEXT bundle dispatched to subagents at step 5.1. Backed by Anthropic context-engineering guidance ('smallest set of high-signal tokens') + 2024–2026 research showing LLM-as-reviewer accuracy degrades with prompt complexity. Overflow → @Main attempts to trim optional sub-bundles, then BLOCKED with reason OVERFLOW_TOKENS if still over. 0 = no cap (legacy v6.1 behaviour).

lanes.description: v7.0.0+ (P21) — risk-based pipeline triage (MANDATORY in v7.0.0). @Main's Step 0a CLASSIFY computes a `risk` value for the task (trivial | standard | critical) and routes through a different pipeline density. trivial: short pipeline (no Architect spec, no DoD, no Trace, no diff-review; ground-truth still mandatory). standard: full pipeline. critical: standard + adversarial 2nd pass + mutation-sample backend artefact + sleep mode forbidden. Per PIPELINE_V7_PROPOSAL.md § 5.

default_risk.description: Fallback risk when @Main cannot determine from heuristics and PO did not pass --risk explicitly. standard is the safe default — overflows escalate, never undershoots.

trivial_max_files.description: Maximum files a trivial-lane task may touch. Overflow auto-reclassifies to standard with a notice.

trivial_max_lines.description: Maximum lines added+removed for a trivial-lane task. Overflow auto-reclassifies.

trivial_no_new_public_symbols.description: Trivial lane forbids new public functions/types/endpoints/exports. true = enforce; false = allow (for projects where 'trivial' is shorthand for 'small but allowed to introduce a public symbol').

critical_block_sleep.description: Refuse /kit-sleep for critical-lane tasks. Critical risk + autonomous run is the highest blast-radius combination; default true blocks at /kit-sleep startup. Set false only if you accept the trade-off.

critical_require_mutation_sample.description: Critical lane backend steps require a mutation-sample with ≥3 mutants killed (vs ≥1 for standard backend). Pure-UI/API/CLI critical steps still require their respective ground-truth types.

auto_classify.description: Let @Main infer risk at Step 0a from heuristics (file count estimate, public-API touch, security-surface keywords, Critical EC presence). false = always require explicit --risk flag in /kit-new-feature; missing flag falls back to default_risk.

mutation_sample.description: v7.1.0+ — mutation-sample skill configuration. Used by the 5.6 ground-truth gate when REQUIRED_TYPE = mutation-sample-pass (backend steps in standard / critical lanes), and by the /kit-mutate ad-hoc command. Disable by setting all fields to lane-skipping defaults (e.g. max_mutants: 0 acts as kill-switch — gate falls back to manual /kit-attach).

max_mutants.description: Hard cap on generated mutants per invocation. 0 = effectively disabled (skill skips and the 5.6 gate falls back to manual /kit-attach with type=mutation-sample-pass).

timeout_seconds.description: Per-mutant test-run timeout. Mutants that exceed this are counted as survived (worst-case). Increase for slow test suites; decrease to bound cost on fast suites.

fallback_ai.description: When true, the skill uses AI-driven mutation if the language's native tool (PIT / Stryker / mutmut / Gremlins / cargo-mutants) is not installed. When false (default), missing-tool BLOCKs the 5.6 gate and surfaces install instructions to PO. AI mutation is lower fidelity than native tooling — opt-in only when install is impractical.

scope.description: Mutation scope. all_changed: all files in CHANGED_FILES (default). smallest_file_only: only the smallest file by line count (cost-saving for large steps). diff_lines_only: only lines added/modified by this step's diff (cost-saving but may miss regressions in untouched lines that the change relies on).

telemetry.description: v6.3+ (P20) — gate-signal-ratio telemetry. Each gate verdict is appended to `evals/runs/<kit_version>/gates.csv` via the gate-telemetry skill (opt-in by directory presence). At task CLOSE the eval-collector skill aggregates per-task signal_ratio into the per-task record. /kit-status shows rolling cross-task signal_ratio over the last `evaluation_window_tasks` tasks; gates with rolling signal_ratio below `signal_ratio_threshold` AND no defect_origin matches are flagged as deprecation candidates. Together with defects.csv (P19, v6.2+), this is the kit's self-cleaning gate-evaluation mechanism.

gates_log_enabled.description: Master switch for gate-telemetry skill. true = log every gate verdict to gates.csv (skipped silently if evals/runs/<kit_version>/ does not exist). false = suppress all gate-csv writes (escape hatch for projects that don't want filesystem writes during agent runs).

evaluation_window_tasks.description: Rolling window size (in distinct tasks) for /kit-status gate-signal aggregation. Larger window = more stable ratio but slower to react to gate quality drift.

signal_ratio_threshold.description: Gates with rolling signal_ratio below this threshold AND no false_negatives in window are flagged 🟡 deprecation_candidate by /kit-status. Per PIPELINE_V7_PROPOSAL § 8.2: gate that does not earn its token cost across N tasks should be removed in next minor release.

ground_truth.description: v6.2+ (P18) — ground-truth artefact gate at 5.6 CHECKPOINT. Backed by Anthropic harness guidance: e2e verification through browser automation / command output / contract tests is critical, AI-only review has measurable accuracy ceiling. Per-step PO must attach one of: screenshot (ui), command-output diff (cli), contract-test pass (api), mutation-sample report (backend). Or override per-step via /kit-approve --no-ground-truth (logged as technical debt in test-cases.md Defects log) or project-wide via required: false (logged once per task).

required.description: Enforce 5.6 ground-truth gate project-wide. false = skip the gate entirely (log once per task as 'gate disabled project-wide'). Default true.

exclusions.description: Module-level exclusions. List module names (matching modules[].name) where the gate is skipped. Useful for pure-headless modules where there is no visual surface and mutation-sample is too expensive. Each excluded module's steps still log Source: ground-truth-excluded for traceability.

default_types.description: Override the @Main 5.6 type-inference defaults. Each key maps a step pattern to a REQUIRED_TYPE. @Main checks these in order; first match wins; falls back to built-in inference (see kit/_shared/agents/Main.body.md.template § 5.6 @ GROUND-TRUTH ARTEFACT GATE).

test_strategy.description: v6.0+ controls the order of test-vs-code writing in @CodeWriter. tdd_first (default, v5 behaviour): failing tests before production code. test_after: production code first, then tests against actual behaviour with @Reviewer Pass A4 enforcing assertion quality. mixed: tdd_first for AC-bound steps, test_after for exploratory/spike steps (CodeWriter picks per step). Two forms: (a) string for the project default; (b) object with {default, allow_per_step_override}.

allow_per_step_override.description: If true, individual steps in plan.md may declare `test_strategy: <mode>` to override the project default.

ci_host.description: v6.0+ marks the CI runtime so the kit can render a real CI workflow (P10). Currently supported: github (renders kit/.github/workflows/kit-gates.yml mirroring in-session lint/build/test gates). Required iff capability profile `ci-github` is in stack.profiles. Omit otherwise — the kit still works but real-CI gates are not deployed.

session_isolation.description: v6.1+ controls per-step clean-session automation. mode=per_step: @Main nudges PO toward /clear after every 5.6 CHECKPOINT (default; matches the vertical-slicing workflow). mode=per_milestone: nudge only before 5.7 RECONCILE and 5.10 diff-review. mode=overflow_only: nudge only on slice-cap overflow / replan / BLOCKED. prompt_style=silent: SessionStart hook injects context via additionalContext (Claude Code) / .planning/.session-bootstrap.md (OpenCode), no visible reminder. prompt_style=stderr: hook prints reminder to stderr before first PO input. prompt_style=both (default): silent injection + stderr reminder.

auto_commit_per_step.description: v6.1+ commits after each step's @Reviewer CLEAN (step 5.4b). Required for /kit-step-resume — clean-session-per-step relies on step_commits[] shas as anchor points. Set to false only if external commit policy conflicts; in that case /kit-step-resume falls back to last-known-state read without per-step revert capability.

allow_internal_steps.description: v6.1+ controls the runnable-slice gate at @Main step 3a. If false (default), every plan step must declare a user-visible Runnable: line; @Main BLOCKs PLAN if any step declares 'Runnable: internal — ...'. Set true for pure-backend modules with no UI surface where vertical slicing is impractical.

auto_approve.description: Controls whether @Main skips the CONFIRM step. Three forms: (a) boolean — same setting for all task classes; (b) object with per-class flags; (c) v6.0+ adds the diff_review key (mandatory PO eye on the full diff between EXECUTE and CLOSE — defaults to false even when other classes are auto-approved; this is the single-PO-eye gate that cannot be obscured by class-level autos). Other gates (DEPLOY, DESTROY, SECRET_ROTATE, MIGRATION, EXTERNAL_API) always require explicit PO approval — auto_approve does not affect them. Replaces the v4 AUTO_APPROVE=true magic string and @AutoApprover agent. Granular form added in v5.1; diff_review added in v6.0.

oneOf.description: Simple form: true = auto-approve all classes; false = always confirm.
Granular form: per-class booleans. Missing keys default to false.

feature.description: Auto-approve FEATURE pipeline CONFIRM (after PLAN, before EXECUTE).

bug.description: Per-severity auto-approve for /kit-fix BUG pipeline. Missing keys default to false. Severity is read from the Defects log entry; for free-form intake without an explicit severity, Status FAIL on a TC verifying a Critical EC = critical, otherwise medium.

diff_review.description: v6.0+ — auto-approve the diff-review gate between EXECUTE and CLOSE (P2). Default false even when feature/tech/bug are all true. Setting this to true bypasses the only mandatory PO-eye gate; do not enable lightly.

profiles.description: List of profile names to merge. Each profile declares an _profile_axis (language|framework|provider|capability). Cardinality rules: exactly one language profile, exactly one provider profile, zero or more framework profiles, zero or more capability profiles. Within a single axis, fields are exclusive (no overlap), so merge order within an axis is irrelevant; across axes, each axis owns disjoint fields. Manifest values still win over any merged profile value.

external_profiles.description: Map of profile name → source URL for profiles fetched from outside the kit repo via /kit-extend. Names here MUST also appear in stack.profiles. Used by /kit-update so external profiles can be re-validated without 404s on RAW_BASE/profiles/<axis>/<name>.yaml.

provider.description: OpenCode provider config. Required iff 'opencode' ∈ hosts. Ignored when only 'claude-code' is in hosts (Claude Code uses Anthropic native models via the Claude Code CLI/desktop).

models.description: OpenCode model role assignments (used as {{PROVIDER_ID}}/{{MODEL}} in opencode.json and agent frontmatter). Required iff 'opencode' ∈ hosts. v7.0.0 roster: 4 OpenCode subagents (Architect, CodeWriter, Verifier, BugFixer) + small. `models.architect` and `models.verifier` are optional — fall back to `models.reviewer` if absent (matches the v6.x convention where multiple legacy agents shared the reviewer model).

reviewer.description: Default model for @Architect and @Verifier when `models.architect` / `models.verifier` are absent. Named `reviewer` for v6.x compatibility — actual usage in v7.0.0 covers Architect/Verifier dispatch.

architect.description: v7.0.0+ — model for @Architect. Optional; falls back to `models.reviewer` if absent or null.

verifier.description: v7.0.0+ — model for @Verifier. Optional; falls back to `models.reviewer` if absent or null.

claude_code.description: Claude Code runtime config. Required iff 'claude-code' ∈ hosts. Models accept the Claude Code CLI aliases (opus | sonnet | haiku) or full model IDs. v7.0.0 roster: 4 subagents (Architect, CodeWriter, Verifier, BugFixer) — main session is the orchestrator.

reviewer.description: Default for @Architect/@Verifier when their dedicated entries are absent. Named for v6.x compatibility.

architect.description: v7.0.0+ — model for @Architect. Optional; falls back to `reviewer`.

verifier.description: v7.0.0+ — model for @Verifier. Optional; falls back to `reviewer`.

allOf.description: If opencode is in hosts, provider/models must be present.
If claude-code is in hosts, claude_code block must be present.
If capability profile ci-github is selected, ci_host must be set to github (v6.0+).
